anchor.semantic_hook: The literal idea of being inside the logic of things is staged as a chamber enclosed by a visible chain of ordinary objects, each one causing the next to move.
anchor.setting: A vast cause-and-effect chamber contains a continuous track of interlocking office tools, household objects, wheels, and ramps. The track curls around the central floor so every consequence visibly follows its cause. The entire room-sized chain moves by itself in perfect sequence, the single impossible mechanism that makes the logic of things tangible.
anchor.absurd_element: a room-sized chain of ordinary objects that propels itself in perfect causal order
